passwd_file.description: Path to the password file for plain authentication.

tcp_port.description: TCP port number for the VPN service.

udp_port.description: UDP port number for the VPN service.

run_as_user.description: User account to run worker processes as.

run_as_group.description: Group account to run worker processes as.

socket_file.description: Socket file used for server IPC (worker-main).

server_cert.description: Path to the server certificate file.

server_key.description: Path to the server key file.

ca_cert.description: Path to the Certificate Authority file.

max_clients.description: Limit the number of concurrent clients.

max_same_clients.description: Limit the number of identical clients (users connecting multiple times).

rate_limit_ms.description: Rate limit incoming connections in milliseconds.

server_stats_reset_time.description: Period in seconds for resetting server statistics.

dpd.description: Dead peer detection interval in seconds.

mobile_dpd.description: Dead peer detection for mobile clients in seconds.

switch_to_tcp_timeout.description: Time in seconds before switching to TCP if no UDP traffic.

cert_user_oid.description: OID for reading user ID in client certificates.

auth_timeout.description: Time in seconds allowed for client to authenticate.

min_reauth_time.description: Time in seconds a client cannot reconnect after failed authentication.

max_ban_score.description: Ban score threshold for banning clients.

ban_reset_time.description: Time in seconds to reset client ban score.

deny_roaming.description: Whether roaming is allowed (restrict cookie to single IP).

use_occtl.description: Enable support for the occtl tool.

predictable_ips.description: Whether generated IPs will be predictable.

ping_leases.description: Ping IP addresses before leasing to verify they are not in use.

route_1.description: First route to forward to clients.

route_2.description: Second route to forward to clients.

route_3.description: Third route to forward to clients.

cisco_client_compat.description: Enable pre-draft-DTLS version for Cisco client compatibility.

cisco_svc_client_compat.description: Enable settings for Cisco SVC IPPhone clients.

camouflage_secret.description: Secret string for camouflage URL prefix.

camouflage_realm.description: Realm for HTTP authentication camouflage prompt.
